name: cylindrical layer element
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中以柱状分层形式描述隧道及土体的半解析单元。
usage_overview: 用于圆形隧道及同心分层土体的半解析动力建模，可参与三维列车—轨道—隧道—土体耦合分析。在这类几何与分层条件下，仅需沿径向离散，以描述隧道及周围土体的动力行为。

complete_examples.text: Railway tunnel Train-track-tunnel-soil coupled dynamics Soil dynamic stress Environmental vibration Cylindrical layer element Semi-analytical modeling A B S T R A C T A 3D train-track-tunnel-soil (TTTS) coupled dynamics model is developed in the time domain, where the spatial dynamic interactions between the subsystems can be characterized and captured.
In this paper, a time-domain semi-analytical cylindrical layer element (CLE) is proposed to establish a 3D tunnel-soil system dynamics model (Section 2.1), based on our previous works (Yang, 2020).

P072.title: A 3D train-track-tunnel-soil coupled dynamics model based on semi-analytical cylindrical layer element
